articles.title: Bears beat Eagles in Philly, boos rain down on Lincoln Financial
articles.summary: This pivotal NFC showdown ended in close fashion with the Bears recording their fifth straight win.

articles.title: Bears' win in Philly sends message: 'We're for real'
articles.summary: The Bears' 24-15 win over the Eagles went a long way toward legitimizing their surprising run this season, with several players saying they're "changing the culture" after winning nine of their past 10 games.

articles.title: Eagles to 'evaluate everything' after home loss
articles.summary: Coach Nick Sirianni stood by offensive coordinator Kevin Patullo on Friday, saying he will not change playcallers after another disappointing performance for the group that factored into the Philadelphia Eagles' 24-15 home loss to the Chicago Bears.

articles.title: Tomlin: Rodgers 'all systems go' to play Sunday
articles.summary: Aaron Rodgers is "all systems go" this week, according to coach Mike Tomlin, after the veteran quarterback missed last week's loss while dealing with a left wrist fracture.

articles.title: Bowles: Baker trending toward playing vs. Cards
articles.summary: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles told reporters Friday that quarterback Baker Mayfield is trending toward playing Sunday when they host the Cardinals.

articles.title: Giants' Dart to start MNF; 'been waiting' to play
articles.summary: After missing the past two games while in concussion protocol, rookie Jaxson Dart has reclaimed his spot as the Giants' QB1 and will return to face the Patriots on Monday night.

articles.title: Darnold grateful to Vikes but focused on Seahawks
articles.summary: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold wasn't in an overly reflective mood while answering questions about facing his former team but expressed gratitude for his resurgent season in Minnesota.

articles.title: Surtain thrilled to return for 1st-place Broncos
articles.summary: Denver Broncos cornerback Pat Surtain II, a two-time first-team All-Pro and the reigning Defensive Player of the Year, said he feels a little "anxious," but is more than ready to return to the lineup for Sunday's contest against the Washington Commanders.

articles.title: Chargers rule out rookie RB Hampton for Sunday
articles.summary: Coach Jim Harbaugh and the Los Angeles Chargers on Friday ruled out rookie running back Omarion Hampton, who hasn't played since Week 5 because of an ankle injury, for Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders.
